actions.action: Dig into the soil to check where it is wet or dry (weekly)
Water if the soil is dry
Log time since last rain or watering, time of day watered, frequency and efficiency

verdict.reason: This generic outdoor-garden video blames most wilting on heat, wind or pressure and warns against watering, so it mentions thirst only conditionally; its 'if the soil is dry, water' step is the fix, buried but protected by a soil check.
